LESSON: THE FALL OF MAN

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.3: The Fall of Man

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Fall of Man
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to obey God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for The Fall of Man.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to obey God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the fall of man according to Genesis 3:1-11

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
